author: SickProdigy
description: Connect each Discord server to its own MyBB API, let members add personal scoped access, browse and search recent threads, and publish reviewed Discord messages.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each guild's MyBB board URL, enablement, default forum ID, forum aliases, manager role ID, and a marker for each member who connected personal access. Guild and personal bearer tokens are stored separately in Red shared API tokens and are removed on disconnect or user-data deletion.
install_msg: Run `[p]mybbset setup` with Manage Server to connect this Discord server to its MyBB board using a restricted API token. Members can optionally run `[p]mybb connect` for personal access.
name: MyBB
short: Per-server MyBB boards, personal connections, search, and publishing
